title: MORE Markets investigates Flow EVM lending-reserve exploit
description: Blockaid reported that approximately 15.5 million WFLOW left MORE Markets' mFlowWFLOW lending reserve on Flow EVM in an exploit involving an Ankr bonded liquid-staking token and the protocol's E-Mode configuration. Blockaid estimated approximately USD 9.3 million of detector impact. MORE Markets said it was investigating the exploit claim and would publish findings.
notes: The USD value is Blockaid's preliminary detector-impact estimate and must not be presented as a final confirmed protocol or user loss. Root cause, bad debt, recovery and user compensation remained unresolved in the reviewed same-day evidence.
